text: {"sql": "SELECT CASE WHEN t.machine_id IS NULL THEN 'no_match' WHEN t.heat_dissipation_failure = 1 THEN 'heat_dissipation_failure=1' ELSE 'heat_dissipation_failure=0' END AS telemetry_category, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM sf_ops.incidents i LEFT JOIN sf_plant.machine_telemetry t ON i.machine_id = t.machine_id AND date_trunc('HOUR', i.ts) = t.ts WHERE i.kind = 'machine_overheat' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY incident_count DESC", "columns": ["telemetry_category", "incident_count"], "purpose": "Count machine_overheat incidents by matched telemetry heat_dissipation_failure status (1, 0, or no match)"}
